title: Tomato Relish - quick and easy
preamble:
Ingredients:-
2
small onions, finely chopped
10
small tomatoes, finely chopped
3
cloves garlic
Half
green chilli
75
g brown sugar
75
ml wine vinegar
1
cinnamon stick
tabasco,
to taste

2
small onions, finely chopped
10
small tomatoes, finely chopped
3
cloves garlic
Half
green chilli
75
g brown sugar
75
ml wine vinegar
1
cinnamon stick
tabasco,
to taste

Method:-
Heat a little oil in a frying pan and cook the onions until softened.
Add the tomatoes, chilli and garlic and mix well, then add the sugar, vinegar and cinnamon and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Season to taste with Tabasco sauce, salt and pepper and set aside to cool.
